title: Respect!, exhibition design
excerpt: Exhibition design with light and interaction for Respect! Perspectieven in de hedendaagse kunst, at Museum De Voorde in Zoetermeer.
description:
Respect! Perspectieven in de hedendaagse kunst ran at Museum De Voorde in Zoetermeer from 5 February to 2 October 2022, the show the museum reopened with. Eighteen Dutch artists worked to the theme of respect, among them Rob Sweere, Frode Bolhuis, Marjolijn Mandersloot, Tobias Becker Hoff and spoken word artist Amara van der Elst. I made the exhibition design, with light and interaction carrying the route through the rooms rather than sitting on top of the work.
> Designing an exhibition is deciding what a visitor meets first, and what they are still carrying when they reach the last room. Light does that quietly: it sets the order in which things are seen.
credits: Exhibition design, light and interaction: Jaco Schilp. Respect! Perspectieven in de hedendaagse kunst, the reopening exhibition at Museum De Voorde, Zoetermeer, 5 February to 2 October 2022, with eighteen Dutch artists.
